title_en: American Horror Story Season 13 Just Revealed New Poster and a Cryptic Plot Teases
summary_en: Ryan Murphy's dark and disturbing series - drops a new poster, episode titles and short synopses for installments 4-6.
body_en:
Someone over at Hulu decided to lock in on the social media campaign for American Horror Story 13 — the latest in Ryan Murphy's dark and disturbing series — dropping a new poster, episode titles and short synopses for installments 4–6.
The poster is classic Murphy, featuring a figure in a full black latex gimp suit, brandishing a giant black sunflower. Several characters have rocked the outfit — also known as the Rubber Man costume — throughout previous seasons, most notably Tate Langdon (played by Evan Peters in American Horror Story: Murder House).
That makes sense, as Murphy told Vogue that 13 would see some of the show's most popular characters return. "I just thought the number 13 was infused with so much stuff in the horror genre, and I wanted to do a greatest hits season," Murphy said.
The episode titles listed are:
Meanwhile, the plot teases for each are a sexy ankle flash of the horrible delights that await in episodes 4–6.
American Horror Story 13 will premiere just in time for spooky season, on FX on September 24, 2026.
Rachel Weber is the Head of Editorial Development at IGN and an elder millennial. She's been a professional nerd since 2006 when she got her start on Official PlayStation Magazine in the UK, and has since worked for GamesIndustry.Biz, Rolling Stone and GamesRadar. She loves horror, horror movies, horror games, Red Dead Redemption 2, and her Love and Deepspace boyfriends.
